body:
### Problem

I don't know about terminal internals well enough to say if this is a Neovim bug, tmux bug, or an interaction between the two. I found #17285 and #39803 while browsing the tracker and wondered if they're related.

Neovim doesn't pick up pane resizes under tmux control mode, and the two directions fail differently:

- Widening the pane: Neovim's layout stays exactly the same - it doesn't expand into the new space.
- Narrowing the pane: Neovim's layout becomes garbled instead of shrinking cleanly.

Other programs in the same pane (`top`, `tig`, plain `vim`) resize correctly in both directions, so this seems specific to Neovim. Reproduced consistently on both iTerm2 and RootShell, using each one's tmux control mode integration.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a terminal with tmux control mode enabled (tested on iTerm2 and RootShell).
2. Start a tmux session, open two panes side-by-side, run `nvim --clean` in the left pane.
3. Widen the pane, observe Neovim's layout does not expand, staying at the old width.
4. Narrow the pane, observe Neovim's layout becomes garbled rather than cleanly shrinking.

Additional checks:

- `stty size` and `tmux display -p '#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}'` report the new, correct dimensions after either resize.
- `kill -WINCH <nvim_pid>` (sent from another pane) has no effect.
- `kill -TSTP <nvim_pid>` followed by `kill -CONT <nvim_pid>` has no effect.
- Manually suspending/resuming the job myself in the shell (Ctrl-Z, then `fg`) fixes it immediately, and Neovim redraws at the correct size.

### Expected behavior

Neovim should resize to match the new pane dimensions in both directions - expanding when the pane is widened and shrinking cleanly when narrowed - the same way `top`, `tig`, and plain `vim` do in the same pane.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

0.12.4

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no, vim 9.1.1752

### Operating system/version

macOS 26.5.1

### Terminal name/version

rootshell 1.0.10 (105), iTerm2 3.6.11, tmux 3.6b/3.7b

### $TERM environment variable

tmux-256color

### Installation

homebrew
title: Neovim doesn't resize correctly under tmux control mode
